patch_summary: Widen the dynamic HiF4 scale grid from 6 to 20 candidates, all inside the legal E6M2 set (offsets -2..2 x multipliers 1.0/1.25/1.5/1.75). No caller passes a grid, so this reaches q, k and v without bypassing the rotation and smoothing in the parent pipeline. Structure-agnostic, no counterpart, no fitted state.
